image_description: A close-up, vertical shot of a grey whale breaching or spy-hopping in deep blue ocean water. The whale's head and upper torso are visible above the surface, oriented vertically. The skin is dark grey/black with significant white mottling consistent with barnacles and cyamids. The mouth appears slightly open or the rostrum is arched. Water splashes around the base where the body meets the surface. No dorsal fin is visible on the exposed portion.
